name: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 3: Echoes of the Rebellion
summary: Season 3 is starting to heat up—or should we say ice up? Highlights include: the arrival of Pilbush, the new Hoth Frontline battlefield, the Season 3 Arena Pass, Emotes, new Limited Time Events, the return of Boulder Bash, and much more!
